# Bike rental data: loading and transformations

```{r bike-data-loading}
bike_raw <- read.csv("data/day.csv")

season_factor <- factor(bike_raw$season)
season_matrix <- model.matrix(~ season_factor)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
colnames(season_matrix) <- c("season_2", "season_3", "season_4")

bike <- cbind(
  bike_raw[, names(bike_raw) != "season"],
  as.data.frame(season_matrix)
)
```

```{r bike-transformations}
bike$misty <- as.integer(bike$weathersit == 2)
bike$RAIN <- as.integer(bike$weathersit %in% c(3, 4))
bike$temp <- bike$temp * (39 + 8) - 8
bike$hum <- bike$hum * 100
bike$windspeed <- bike$windspeed * 67
bike$days_since_2011 <- as.integer(as.Date(bike$dteday) - as.Date("2011-01-01"))

bike_clean <- bike[, c(
  "workingday",
  "holiday",
  "season_2",
  "season_3",
  "season_4",
  "misty",
  "RAIN",
  "temp",
  "hum",
  "windspeed",
  "days_since_2011",
  "cnt"
)]
```
